newsitem.title: PERU: Japanese arrested for photographing Peru siege.
newsitem.headline: Japanese arrested for photographing Peru siege.

text.p: Peruvian police said on Thursday they arrested a tourist for taking an unauthorised picture of the Japanese ambassador's residence where Marxist rebels are holding 72 hostages.
The police said Akaki Tadaki, 21, declared he was just a curious tourist. They said he would be released later in the day and no charges would be pressed.

Although the residence in a plush Lima neighbourhood has become a big tourist magnet since it was taken over by rebels 100 days ago, authorities only allow accredited journalists to take photographs of the site.
Streets around the residence are blocked to the traffic and patrolled by heavily armed soldiers.
